drhp.business: The company manufactures flexible, multi-functional packaging material and provides end-to-end flexible packaging solutions across various industries. It was engaged in trading of flexible packaging material until 2015, and commenced manufacturing in 2017.
drhp.expansion: Board approved setting up a new manufacturing facility at SP 1 Industrial Area (RICO), Visnodha, Dholpur, Rajasthan, on a lease basis from promoter group company Osho Tradeflex Private Limited, with the stated aim of increasing production capacity with optimum utilisation of resources. Trial production began w.e.f. 01.02.2026, with the new plant having a production capacity of 800 tonnes per month. This follows the loss of "Plant 1" (540 tonnes/month, Noida) to a fire accident on 15.02.2025; "Plant 2" (540 tonnes/month, Noida) continues to operate.

risks.note: The company derives majority of its revenue from the State of Uttar Pradesh, heightening exposure to competitive, economic and demographic developments specific to that region.
The company is dependent on a few large customers for sales; loss of any of them may affect revenues and profitability.
The company is dependent on a few large suppliers for purchase of product; loss of any of these suppliers may affect business operations.
The business depends on its manufacturing facilities and is subject to risks such as equipment breakdown or failure, industrial accidents, severe weather conditions and natural disasters.
A major fire accident on 15.02.2025 destroyed one plant and temporarily disrupted operations; the related insurance claim is still ongoing at the time of reporting.
Although required after listing, an internal auditor was not appointed during FY2025-26 because the company was engaged with the fire insurance claim process.
